title: Taxonomy / Botanical Classification Verification — Certification
reframing_note: Originally scoped as "fix the squash-family taxonomy drift." docs/VEGETABLE_GOVERNANCE.md names the group itself "Root Vegetables & Squash" and states directly: "Squash and carrot-class roots belong in Root Vegetables." All 9 squash-family entities were verified to conform exactly. That finding is retracted — see reports/aq-03-retraction-notice.md.

named_governance_exceptions_verified.NUT-001 (peanut culinary grouping): PASS — peanut correctly filed under nut-seed/peanuts group; correctly absent from legume catalog (no cross-domain duplication per LEGUME-001).
named_governance_exceptions_verified.BOTAN-001 (cilantro leaf vs coriander se: PASS — cilantro (fresh-herbs group) and coriander-seed (whole-spices group) are correctly separate canonical entities sharing scientific_name Coriandrum sativum, matching governance's own example exactly.
named_governance_exceptions_verified.BOTAN-001 (dill leaf vs dill seed): PASS — dill (fresh-herbs) and dill-seed (whole-spices) correctly separate, same scientific_name Anethum graveolens.

classification_candidate_scan.note: Advisory only — requires governance/editorial confirmation before being treated as a finding.

methodology: Two independent checks: (1) structural integrity — every entity's parent_group and every group's parent_category must resolve to a real record, a genuine defect class regardless of culinary judgment; (2) a bounded plant_part-vs-group-name heuristic scan, explicitly advisory-only per the squash lesson — any hit would require governance confirmation before being reported as a finding, not asserted directly.
